body.name: Finite ordinary label and slice data \(\Lambda_{\mathbf B}\)
body.construction: For every \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\), set \(\Lambda_{\mathbf B}=\{\ell_{i,b}:i\in[t],\ b\in\mathfrak X_{B_i}\}\). The label \(\ell_{i,b}\) is the exact \(|\mathrm{LIT}|\)-bit vector assigning each RAND action \(r_v\in S_{B_i}\) the coordinate \(b_v\) and all unconditioned literal bits zero. The protocol contains the adequate READ set \(\{\rho_v:v\in V\}\), and \(\operatorname{Slice}(S_{B_i},\ell_{i,b})=Q[V\setminus B_i](\cdot;b)=P_b(V\setminus B_i)\). The family has exactly \(\sum_{i=1}^{t}\prod_{v\in B_i}|\mathfrak X_v|\) labelled slices before duplicate intervention sets are coalesced.
